label: Rosalie Iemhoff, Intuitionism in the…: Every instance of excluded middle is irrefutable: ∀ p, ¬¬.…
locator: §3.4, Weak counterexamples, 'In other words, ¬¬(B ∨ ¬B) is intuitionistically true'
interpretation: Attribution reading: the entry reports that for any statement B a contradiction follows from ¬B and ¬¬B, 'in other words, ¬¬(B ∨ ¬B) is intuitionistically true', so that although there are weak counterexamples to excluded middle, its negation is intuitionistically refutable. Records that the intuitionist is committed to the same constructive theorem as LOGIC-EXCLUDED-MIDDLE-IRREFUTABLE.
